title: Exactness from specified Artin-Schreier section data
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and p a prime with p = 0 in Γ(X,O_X). Let G be an abelian sheaf on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with natural additive equivalences a_U:G(U)≃Γ(U,O_U). Suppose given wp:G→G and iota:constant Z/p→G [def-sc-constant-sheaves], with zero composite, satisfying under a the formulas wp(x)=x^p-x and iota(c)=c.val on the constant-presheaf unit. Then the resulting short complex is short exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence].

source.place: Opening Artin-Schreier short exact sequence for every scheme in characteristic p, together with the proof of Tag 03PL for local surjectivity.

proof.text: Pull hp back to each etale object U and apply the polynomial-cover theorem to the function a_U(s). Its surjective etale arrow gives a singleton covering family in X.smallEtaleTopology. The lift a_V.symm ω and the hwp and hrestr formulas show that its generator belongs to the image sieve. Upward closure of covering sieves gives local surjectivity of wp; the sheaf-epimorphism criterion then gives Epi wp.

Apply the section-kernel theorem to obtain a limiting KernelFork.ofι iota hzero. A limiting fork arrow is monic and ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel gives exactness. Package these with the epimorphism proved above using ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk.

proof_origin.place: Kernel identification plus local surjectivity by the polynomial construction adapted from 03PL; explicit Lean assembly by C1.

from.place: Local surjectivity and kernel identification for specified maps

lean.statement:
theorem artinSchreier_section_data_shortExact (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hp : (p : Γ(X, ⊤)) = 0)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (a : ∀ U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (wp : G ⟶ G) (iota : X.constantZMod p ⟶ G) (hzero : iota ≫ wp = 0)
    (hrestr : ∀ (U V : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x))
    (hwp : ∀ (U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a U (wp.hom.app U x) = (a U x) ^ p - a U x)
    (hiota : ∀ (U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (c : ZMod p),
      a U (iota.hom.app U
        ((toSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology
          ((Functor.const X.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod p))))).app U (ULift.up c))) =
        (c.val : Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))) :
    (ShortComplex.mk iota wp hzero).ShortExact
